newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares ease in quiet pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares ease in quiet pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Istanbul shares edged lower in range-bound and quiet pre-holiday trade on Friday, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed three points, or 0.19 percent lower at 1,553 after falling from an early high of 1,581. Trade volume also eased to 31.86 trillion lira ($270.4 million) from Thursday's 33.80 trillion ($288.3 million).

Turkish markets will be closed from Saturday for a Moslem holiday and reopen on February 12, Wednesday. Today's settlements were delayed to next Thursday and yesterday's settlements to next Wednesday.
Brokers said share prices drifted lower in quiet afternoon selling in line with previous expectations that players might shy away from keeping long share positions over the holiday.

The index recovered 6.21 percent in the last two days following a 13.82 percent down correction by Tuesday's close from the January 27 all-time high closing of 1,700. It had surged 74.2 percent from end-1996 to January 27 in a strong uptrend.
